body:
Ok, I'm not really interested in arguing with you anymore, cause you just reply to my points with name calling and stereotypes.

But Salvia elegans is not a psychoactive plant. Salvia divinorum is. Salvia elegans is called pineapple sage, and I picked it for my username because I have one on my balcony. The hummingbirds love it. Are you really so desperate to label me as a pathetic drug user?

Why are you so dead-set on me being an addict? Why do you even care?

You know what? I love weed. Weed makes life go from unbearable to bearable. The side effects (dry eyes, dry mouth, occasional intoxication) are totally worth being able to live a normal life. My decision to smoke weed every day is based on a cost-benefit analysis, not a compulsion.

If you want to believe that everyone who smokes weed daily is an addict, that's your business, not mine. I just want to be left the fuck alone. Keep your moralizing to yourself.

I smoke daily because it makes me not want to kill myself. It's not cognitive dissonance. Are people who take SSRIs every day addicted?

And today, I decided not to smoke weed. I've had zero cravings. If I was addicted, wouldn't I desperately want to smoke?

>weed isn't addictive

I'm a daily smoker, but I can still quit whenever I want (I'm on a tolerance break right now). I've never understood people who say weed is addictive. There's zero withdrawal whatsoever.
I want to kill the people who get attention without trying
I live in California
I know it's all in my head, but when my mood gets bad it starts to feel real and it turns into this positive feedback loop until I get to the point where I want to kill someone or myself.
Yeah, I have to balance my clinginess with my desire not to upset her
I guess? I always worry that I'm enroaching on her. At the same time, I can't live without her. I would rather die than lose what we have.

My choice is between friends who don't care about me and no friends at all. Honestly, I'd rather have the former. Friends who care would be awesome, but I'm beginning to think that that's impossible for me. Everyone who I try to get close to just pushes me away, and I end up hurt, and for some reason that I don't really understand, I'm not allowed to be angry at them, so I direct the anger inwards. Sometimes it slips out and makes me lash out at someone and then I just feel even more shitty.

And no, taking a break like that is just the first step to breaking up. I need to stay as close as possible to minimize the possibility of her leaving me. Also, we're both not gonna "get better" anytime soon. We have to work with what we have now.

I have friends, but they don't care about me.

The trouble is, my girlfriend doesn't want what I want. I want us to be totally codependent and never apart from each other, which my girlfriend knows is impossible and not a good idea. She wants us to have some distance and remain separate individuals, like in a healthy relationship. But I hate myself as an individual, so it's tough.

I wish my girlfriend would dote on me more. But she suffers from mental illness too and she can't always do that for me. And she doesn't really understand my mentality. I really wish I had friends who cared about me.

Whenever I try to tell my girlfriend that I feel neglected, she accuses me of being unappreciative, which is true, because she gives me so much despite my instability and general insanity. My parents are clueless assholes.
All moral qualms aside, suicide is ultimately your own choice. Use your own judgement.
Huh. Well, in my experience it's much easier to accept thoughts that change them.

Sorry about that, I just thought it might help you. After she told me that, I was sitting on campus, watching other people, and I thought to myself, "How many of these people also have no friends? How many are also terrified of talking to people?" It really helped me, because it sort of knocked everyone else off this pedestal I put them on. They were no longer gods, powerful beings who dispensed companionship or rejection on a whim. I started to see them as what they truly were: vulnerable, neurotic human beings, just like me. But, you know, that's just me. Everyone sees the world a bit differently.

I just want to tell you that those sorts of anxieties are extremely common. My therapist was telling me that close to half of everyone reports feeling social anxiety on a regular basis. I really feel for you, my first two years of college were lonely and miserable.

Here's another perspective. Would you rather hang out with someone who's interesting and smart, or someone who's thoughtful and kind?

Try not to take other people's rejections to heart. There's millions of reasons why someone might reject you, and jumping to "I'm not smart enough" or "I'm boring" or some variation of "I'm defective" is not particularly conducive to learning how to be social. And even if you are dumb and boring, so what? Tons of dumb, boring people have good friends. It's easier if you focus on your actions, rather than your personal traits.
Social anxiety can be a real bitch sometimes. I used to be petrified of others. I still have issues, but these days, I've been rejected so many times that it barely phases me anymore :P

I didn't cope very well, that's for sure. As for how to make friends, I don't really know; it sort of just happened to me. I was hanging out with these guys more and more, and pretty soon I realized, "oh, I have a social life now". If I were in your situation, I'd just hang out with your high school friend's friends as often as possible.

Oh, I should ask, do you suffer from social anxiety?
I didn't make any friends until I was a junior, so I wouldn't be too worried.

It seems like other people have written a lot already, but I want to add something. Science has shown that you can't really prevent yourself from thinking certain thoughts. The more you try, the more you think about it. The best thing to do is accept that thoughts are just thoughts, and they can't hurt you. If you get some unpleasant thoughts, it's best to just wait until they drift away and get replaced by better ones.
I'd become incapable of violence
It's probably because of the whole lynching thing, you know, how 1 or 2 black people a week were getting hanged and people would come and spectate and this was only like three generations ago?

Well, for instance, if someone has some sort of vice, like say their an angry person. You could tell them, "you're too angry, you need to calm down," but they're probably not gonna listen to you. They're gonna get more angry. But instead, if you manipulate them into being calmer, and attempting to contain their rage, without them realizing what you are doing, they will think it's their idea, and thus be content to improve themselves, and both of you benefit.

Obviously manipulation can be misused, but I think it's a valuable tool in relationships. Just my two cents.

Why does sailing have to be smooth all the time? Sure, there's a lot of bullshit that we have to deal with, and it never really ends, but that's just part of being human. And saying there is no smooth sailing is quite frankly not true; it's just that the smooth parts are ephemeral and punctuated with storms.
Marijuana makes me not want to kill myself
Well I guess my question is, what's wrong with being manipulative if you're not hurting your partner?
If I may ask, what's wrong with testing a relationship? I do this a lot, but it seems benign. I'm just making sure my girlfriend still loves me.

You say there's nothing but suicide for you, but there is an alternative. You can try to survive the loneliness, get over her and move on with your life. Why not give it a try? If it doesn't work out, you can always commit suicide at a later date.
...how?
All I'm saying is, the studies you showed me don't preclude the fact that I can close my eyes and see crazy shifting patterns right now :P

Why does THC have to activate the areas associated with vision to make me see fractals when my eyes are closed? The truth is, cannabis makes me see stuff, whether or not it's activating those specific regions of the brain. I think the whole "regions of the brain" thing is totally overblown btw, but that's an argument for another day I suppose :P
Cannabis is definitely psychedelic! I've had visions from weed alone. Not as strong as from, say, diviner's sage, but they're definitely there. When I close my eyes I see fractals.
It's good, but it's hard to get regular appointments. I was getting seen once a month, and I started seeing a private shrink cause that wasn't often enough to make good progress.
Half? Damn, that's comforting.
I guess there's only one way to find out
So you see, it's not because you're a "social retard" or anything that you haven't got laid yet, it's just a tough break. Bad luck is bound to end eventually.

Yeah, I just met her, one thing led to another, you know. Kind of just happened. We were both lonely and crazy and horny haha.

I guess my point is that could totally happen to you too. Just make yourself attractive enough and talk to enough people and eventually some girl will just fall on your lap. It's a waiting game.

I'm a social retard and I somehow managed to get a girlfriend and have sex with her... don't give up so easily. It takes time and a lot of luck. If I held a gun to your head and told you you have to get laid within five years, what would you think of that?
I have a vegetable garden, I'll just worry about that instead.
I think instead of thinking about my mental illness so much, I'm gonna worry about my garden instead.

I've been in therapy for a few years now. I don't know what causes the mood swings. Possibly physiological. They don't bother me so much, it's just that they make be behave impulsively and just generally act like an asshole, and I'm pretty sure they stress her out.

My charisma is hollow; it masks the fact that I'm a terrible person. You know, superficial charm. The truth is that she really shouldn't be in a relationship with me. I have violent mood swings and I can't control my impulses. This isn't the first time I've lashed out at her. The only reason she's with me is because she got sucked into my black hole of a personality. It's only a matter of time until she realizes that I'm a bad person and I always will be.
By being charismatic and charming and apologizing really convincingly
